notes: Sourced primarily from MA Lighting's official product page (malighting.com) and its linked official datasheet PDF (Art.-No. 4010509, rev. 14.5.2024), cross-checked against the official grandMA3 online help manual. Confirmed connector inventory (14 physical ports): 1x powerCON TRUE1 (AC 100-240V, 50/60Hz, max 200VA), 2x etherCON/RJ45, 8x DMX512-A Out (5-pin XLR female), 3x USB 2.0 Type-A. Unit is 2RU, 482 x 372 x 87mm, 5kg, integrated touchscreen, expands a grandMA3 system by 8,192 parameters (or 4,096 in Mode2 for grandMA2 expansion). Caveats: (1) The etherCON/RJ45 Ethernet grade (eth-1g) is inferred, not printed on this product's own spec sheet — MA Lighting's network-design documentation states MA-Net3 requires a minimum of 1 Gbit/s, so this is a reasonable but indirect inference, hence "medium" confidence. (2) Exact rear-panel silkscreen labels/numbering for the two network ports, eight DMX outputs, and three USB ports were not confirmed from a legible rear-panel diagram (product photos found were too low-resolution to read printed labels); sequential generic names were assigned. (3) DMX outputs are all identical/equivalent (no separate "universe" labeling found) — MA describes them collectively as "8x DMX512-A Out."
